name: DeepSeek Design
description_en: A visual design plugin for editable artifacts inside DeepSeek Harness.
team_reason: 设计研发团队可围绕真实文件修改原型/演示稿并继续交付。
limitations: iPolloWork 第三方产品，source-available 非纯开源；不同插件能力独立。
evidence: README Studio 画布、选中对象 Ask AI、PDF/PPTX。

name: NLUX
description_en: React and JavaScript components for conversational AI interfaces.
team_reason: 前端团队可复用聊天 UI、模型适配与应用模板。
limitations: 修改版 MPL2.0 附使用限制，不应当纯 MPL；模型后端需另接。
evidence: README conversational library、CLI starter 和 adapters。

name: SpecStory
description_en: Tools for capturing coding conversations as searchable and shareable engineering knowledge.
team_reason: 团队可复用历史设计决策、解决方案和提炼技能。
limitations: 多人搜索与同步依赖Cloud，不等于本地工具全含；需注意会话内容范围。
evidence: README 本地history、可选Cloud团队搜索/分享/跨人resume。

name: AntSK
description_en: A .NET AI knowledge-base and agent platform for private deployment.
team_reason: C#团队可提供企业知识问答，并复用角色与私有部署能力。
limitations: 定制许可证保留品牌；特定多租户服务需商业授权；GraphRAG/高级Text2SQL/流程编排属Pro。

name: LiteLLM Agent Control Plane
description_en: A unified interface for running agents across runtimes with sessions and schedules.
team_reason: 团队通过同一UI/API使用多个代理后端并复用会话。
limitations: 控制面依赖各runtime；不从access概述推断完整SSO/RBAC。

name: Xtreme1
description_en: A multimodal training-data platform with assisted annotation and ontology management.
team_reason: 标注团队可统一类别体系、预标注和数据质量复核。
limitations: RLHF为beta，企业版另行提供；标注精度未测。
evidence: README 2D/3D/融合数据、模型预标注、ontology与quality。

name: Passmark
description_en: A Playwright library for natural-language regression tests and multi-model assertions.
team_reason: QA团队可复用浏览器验收步骤和带AI总结的测试报告。
limitations: FSL未来Apache，不是当前纯Apache；多模型一致不保证断言正确。
evidence: README caching、auto-healing、多模型断言及CUA可选。

name: Meta Ads MCP by Pipeboard
description_en: An MCP integration for Meta advertising operations and performance analysis.
team_reason: 营销团队可统一查询广告数据和准备活动修改。
limitations: BSL1.1；其他四广告节点工具不全属本仓，托管服务条件独立，未执行广告修改。

name: uni-api
description_en: A configuration-driven LLM API gateway with routing, retries, and key-level controls.
team_reason: 工程团队可统一多模型入口及故障切换。
limitations: backend-only，用户计费前端属uni-api-web；不要混写为全栈团队门户。
evidence: README负载均衡、冷却、模型key权限。

name: BricksLLM
description_en: An LLM gateway with per-user limits, usage tracking, and request controls.
team_reason: 团队统一key分发、成本限制和模型调用观测。
limitations: 托管dashboard另算；脱敏不保证无遗漏。

name: JXWAF
description_en: A web firewall combining AI-model and semantic traffic analysis.
team_reason: 安全团队可统一业务防护策略和日志。
limitations: 多租户仅云WAF，标准版不含；防护测试为作者自述，不作效果保证。
evidence: README双引擎、标准/专业/云WAF版本表。

name: AVA Voice Agent for Asterisk
description_en: A voice-agent integration for Asterisk and FreePBX with configurable speech and model providers.
team_reason: 客服/通信团队可接入既有PBX并管理语音流程。
limitations: 多安装管理AVA Operator商业早期预览，非MIT Core；通信兼容需验证。

name: Polis
description_en: An AI-assisted platform for gathering opinions and mapping collective sentiment.
team_reason: 团队/社区可收集意见并了解共识和分歧。
limitations: 不是生成式代理；群体解释需合理样本，AGPL附额外许可。

name: Power BI Modeling MCP
description_en: An official MCP interface for creating and validating Power BI semantic models.
team_reason: BI团队可批量维护指标、关系和DAX。
limitations: 公开预览且EULA；不能编辑报表页/布局，模型变更需审阅。

name: AgentBay SDK
description_en: SDKs for cloud sandboxes supporting browser, desktop, mobile, and code workloads.
team_reason: 平台团队可统一代理执行环境接口。
limitations: Apache仅SDK，云沙箱非随仓自托管全部实现；需服务账号。

name: Product Manager Prompts
description_en: Reusable prompts for product discovery, requirements, stakeholder alignment, and delivery.
team_reason: 产品团队可共同复用PRD、用户故事和风险复盘结构。
limitations: 当前CC BY-NC-SA，商业需书面许可；旧MIT副本条件另算。

name: Jonex
description_en: A multimodal knowledge platform combining parsing, wiki, ontology, and retrieval.
team_reason: 团队可把分散内容转成有来源的业务知识服务。
limitations: 自定义Apache附加条件；治理与推理准确性未测。

name: Prometheus by EuniAI
description_en: A coding-agent platform for issue analysis, reproduction, and patch generation.
team_reason: 研发团队可复用知识图驱动的修复验收流程。
limitations: GPL/商业双许可，benchmark和竞品描述未复验。

name: Xalgorix
description_en: An AI security-testing agent with independent finding verification and reports.
team_reason: 安全团队可复核漏洞证据和修复报告。
limitations: 自托管single-operator；团队/RBAC在托管Team，验证成功不保证通用可利用性。

name: Loki Mode
description_en: A spec-driven coding harness with deterministic checks and verification artifacts.
team_reason: 团队可对PR运行检查并保存可审阅证据。
limitations: BSL1.1，计划2030-03-19转Apache；企业服务独立、SAML仍规划，示例可跳过宿主权限。

name: Judgeval
description_en: A Python SDK for agent tracing, behavioral evaluation, and regression analysis.
team_reason: 团队可从生产轨迹构建评测并接告警。
limitations: 服务端监控依Judgment服务，judge可能误判。

name: LandingAI ADE Python
description_en: An official client for grounded document parsing and typed extraction APIs.
team_reason: 文档工程团队可统一PDF/图像抽取和异步作业。
limitations: SDK非完整解析模型开源，需LandingAI服务。

name: Arcade MCP
description_en: A Python MCP framework with authorization-aware tools and evaluations.
team_reason: 集成团队可复用内部API和OAuth工具授权。
limitations: 托管凭据/Cloud不等于MIT框架完整自托管服务。

name: 99AI
description_en: A self-hostable AI web platform with multiple users and model services.
team_reason: 团队可集中提供模型聊天与用户管理。
limitations: 开发版授权另算，不能将全部功能默认视为Apache社区提供。

name: LiveStream Agent Studio
description_en: A Windows workbench for livestream-commerce analysis and content planning.
team_reason: 运营/投放/内容团队复用录屏、转写、流量和脚本产物。
limitations: 首次公开Beta，仅评价测试/内部研究，平台会员权限与云费用另算。
